probes.name: add-len255
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object,n As Long
On Error GoTo Failed
Set f=Range("K3:K8").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=9,String:=String(255,"a"),TextOperator:=0)
Probe=S(f) & "|count=" & Cells.FormatConditions.Count
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Probe="ERR:" & n & "|count=" & Cells.FormatConditions.Count
If Not f Is Nothing Then Probe=Probe & "|" & S(f)
End Function
Function Units(v As String) As String
Dim i As Long
Units=CStr(Len(v))
For i=1 To Len(v)
If i<=12 Or i>Len(v)-3 Then Units=Units & "," & CStr(AscW(Mid(v,i,1)))
Next
End Function
Function S(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
S="type=" & f.Type & ";op="
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
S=S & CStr(f.TextOperator) & ":err" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
S=S & ";text=" & Units(f.Text) & ":err" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
S=S & ";formula=" & Units(f.Formula1) & ":err" & Err.Number
S=S & ";priority=" & f.Priority & ";stop=" & f.StopIfTrue
Exit Function
Failed:
S="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function

Dim f As Object,n As Long
On Error GoTo Failed
Set f=Range("K3:K8").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=9,String:="foo",TextOperator:=0)
f.Text="a" & ChrW(34) & "b"
Probe=S(f) & "|count=" & Cells.FormatConditions.Count
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Probe="ERR:" & n & "|count=" & Cells.FormatConditions.Count
If Not f Is Nothing Then Probe=Probe & "|" & S(f)
End Function
Function Units(v As String) As String
Dim i As Long
Units=CStr(Len(v))
For i=1 To Len(v)
If i<=12 Or i>Len(v)-3 Then Units=Units & "," & CStr(AscW(Mid(v,i,1)))
Next
End Function
Function S(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
S="type=" & f.Type & ";op="
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
S=S & CStr(f.TextOperator) & ":err" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
S=S & ";text=" & Units(f.Text) & ":err" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
S=S & ";formula=" & Units(f.Formula1) & ":err" & Err.Number
S=S & ";priority=" & f.Priority & ";stop=" & f.StopIfTrue
Exit Function
Failed:
S="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
